items.headline: FDA approves new targeted therapy for advanced breast cancer
items.summary: The US Food and Drug Administration approved gedatolisib, sold as Revtorpyk, for adults with a common hormone-receptor-positive, HER2-negative form of locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer that carries a PIK3CA mutation. The approval gives patients and doctors a new targeted treatment option for a cancer subtype that affects a large share of breast cancer patients.
items.why_it_matters: A newly approved targeted drug expands treatment options for one of the most common forms of advanced breast cancer.
